# IMADI Tech

> IMADI Tech is an AI automation company in Karachi, Pakistan, founded by Maria Aziz in May 2026. It builds WhatsApp chatbots and lead follow-up automation, custom ERP and business management systems, and SaaS products for small and mid-sized businesses. It has delivered projects in Pakistan, the UK and Kenya and also takes on clients in the UAE.

Contact: maria@imadi.tech · Website: https://www.imadi.tech

## Services
- [WhatsApp & Instagram lead automation](https://www.imadi.tech/whatsapp-automation/): an AI assistant that replies to every enquiry instantly, shares designs and price ranges, sends PDF quotations, follows up automatically and tracks every lead in a dashboard. Best fit: furniture, kitchen, interior, building supply and logistics businesses.
- [FAQ](https://www.imadi.tech/faq/): pricing model, setup, languages, WhatsApp number questions.

- [ERP & Accounting Platform](https://www.imadi.tech/case-study/uk-logistics-erp/): One integrated platform where posting an invoice automatically reduces stock and writes a balanced journal entry, supplier bills post to the ledger on approval, and every report reads live from the same accounting…
- [SHAH Enterprise Business Suite](https://www.imadi.tech/case-study/shah/): A dedicated business suite built on the ALICO platform, extended with linked document conversion, automatic stock updates and a guided self-service cloud setup.
- [ReNaz: WhatsApp Scrap Collection Platform](https://www.imadi.tech/case-study/renaz/): Customers book pickups by chatting on WhatsApp, choosing a waste category, date and timeslot with per-kg pricing in PKR. Collectors receive and complete jobs on WhatsApp, and administrators see every pickup from…
- [WhatsApp Automation & Operations Platform](https://www.imadi.tech/case-study/uk-logistics-whatsapp/): A WhatsApp-first system on Meta's Cloud API. Customers get instant pallet-rate quotes and place order enquiries; registered corporate clients file damage claims step by step with photos and invoices, and administrators…
- [Company Monitor](https://www.imadi.tech/case-study/company-monitor/): A central platform where company-authorised WhatsApp Business numbers feed one secure inbox, visible by branch and by role.
- [HerCommerce](https://www.imadi.tech/case-study/hercommerce/): A mobile-first, multi-tenant SaaS platform where a woman can create and run an online business: a guided 4-step onboarding, her own storefront, products with variants, WhatsApp ordering, order management, vouchers and…
